insight: Founded in 2020; has raised ~$63M to date and has been cash-flow positive since 2023 — unusual for a legal-AI startup.
name: Darrow
tagline: AI legal intelligence that detects large-scale violations and sizes litigation before it's filed.
description: Darrow is an AI legal-intelligence platform that scans public data to surface harmful events — data-privacy breaches, antitrust, environmental, and financial violations — then estimates the number of victims, predicts outcomes, and sizes a case's value. Its 2026 platform lets plaintiffs' firms run case discovery, evaluation, and portfolio management in one workflow, positioning itself 'upstream' of litigation rather than on downstream legal operations.
edge: Works the plaintiff side — detecting unflagged violations and sizing cases — rather than the contract or research workflows most legal-AI tools automate.

references.title: Darrow Launches a Platform to Manage Litigation Like a Portfolio
